name: skills
works_with: OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 75 more agents
short: One `npx skills` command to install, update and remove AI skills from GitHub and other git hosts across all your coding agents.
what: `skills` is the command line tool for the open agent skills ecosystem. It pulls `SKILL.md` folders from a GitHub repo, another git host, a download URL or a local path and installs them into each coding agent it finds, as symlinks to one copy or as separate copies. It also lists, searches, updates and removes skills, starts a new one from a template, and can hand a single skill to an agent without installing it.
who: Anyone who uses AI skills with more than one coding agent, or who wants one command to keep them current. If you use a single agent and its own plugin system already does the job, you may not need it.
needs: Your usual git, GitHub CLI or SSH login, only for private repos

steps.title: Install a skill set
steps.text: It detects which coding agents you have and asks where to install. If it finds none, it asks you to pick.

steps.title: See what's in a repo first
Install one skill without prompts
steps.text: `-g` installs to your user folder instead of the project, `-a` picks the agent and `-y` skips confirmations.
steps.code: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design -g -a claude-code -y

steps.title: Keep them current
steps.code:
npx skills list
npx skills update

steps.title: Try one without installing
steps.text: This writes the skill to a temporary folder and starts the agent with it.
steps.code: npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines --agent claude-code

try.label: From the README
try.text: Run `npx skills find typescript` to search for skills by keyword, or `npx skills find` on its own for an interactive search.

watch: It collects anonymous usage data by default. Set `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` to turn it off.
For private GitHub repos it tries your git credentials, then GitHub CLI, then SSH. The README says it never reads your stored GitHub CLI token.
Direct download URLs are capped at 10 MiB, 25 MiB extracted and 1,000 files. You can raise the limits with environment variables when you trust the source.
Without `-g`, skills go into the project folder, where they get committed and shared with your team.
